card.name: Adjectives before predictor or determinant
card.fires_on: Describing adjectives such as independent or strongest that come right before a word like predictors or determinant. It appears in research text about risk factors and associations.

modes.label: Strongest before predictors
modes.description: The word strongest placed just before predictors of an outcome such as suicide.
modes.example: these disorders themselves are the<< strongest>> predictors of suicide

modes.label: Independent before determinant
modes.description: The word independent placed before determinant in a statistical finding.
modes.example: S-25-OHD was an<< independent>> determinant of lumbar spine and whole body

card.writes: It pushes the model to write predictor-type words such as predictors, predictive and correlates next.
card.plain: It fires on a describing word that is about to be followed by predictor, as in strongest predictors of an outcome.
